reading.zh: 从左到右：应用层先不提供任何修改/删除通路（appguard），数据库触发器做最终拒绝（trigger），二期唯一放行的是验签结果回写通道（verify-writeback）。
reading.en: Left to right: the application layer exposes no update or delete path (appguard), database triggers give the final refusal (trigger), and the only permitted exception is the verify-result write-back reserved for phase two (verify-writeback).
